rules.statement: A partition action is not necessarily res judicata by a previous partition action, especially if the previous action was dismissed due to non-prosecution and no contest arose on any dispute between the parties.
rules.supporting_quote: "In these circumstances, it would seem that no contest arose in the previous action upon any dispute between the parties to which the explanation in section 207 can apply. In these circumstances, I would follow the decisions in Fernando v. Menikrala (supra) and Sanchi Appu v. Jeeris Appu (supra), and hold that the previous action is not res judicata."
